notes: melodee's page consumes WebMIDI directly (index.html midiOn()): notes pass through to the firmware synth; CC 20..26 = knob roles 0..6 via worklet.js midiKnob() (abs mode computes value - last, which digests the controller's relative 64+-n encoding natively); CC 27 = MASTER. Panel order: SELECT ALGORITHM PRESETS K1 K2 K3 K4 -> CC 20..26; the 14 buttons (FX SEL ENV LFO EDIT GLO HOME SAVE ARP SEQ PLAY REC OCT- OCT+) -> CC 40..53, 127 press / 0 release (melodee ignores them today, other emus can map them). The page emits no MIDI out, so LED feedback is mirror-echo only. With the controller firmware compiled with this map, NO shim is needed: enable the page's knobson option (mode=abs) and play.
